title: USDA's FoodData Central: what is it and why is it needed today?
authors: Fukagawa NK, McKillop K, Pehrsson PR, Moshfegh A, Harnly J, Finley J
funder: All authors are employed by the USDA Agricultural Research Service and have not received external support in the preparation of this manuscript.
authorConflicts: The authors report no conflicts of interest.
result: FoodData Central entries read on 2026-10-21. Oil, olive, extra virgin (Foundation Foods, FDC 748608; 36 samples bought in Virginia, Maryland, California and New York from June to August 2019), per 100 g: total fat (NLEA) 93.7 g; saturated fatty acids 15.4 g (16:0 12.1 g, 18:0 2.59 g); monounsaturated 69.2 g, of which cis-18:1 67.8 g (range 56.9 to 73.2); polyunsaturated 9.07 g, of which 18:2 n-6 cis,cis 8.4 g (5.14 to 14.8) and 18:3 n-3 cis,cis,cis 0.651 g; beta-sitosterol 126 mg. Oil, olive, salad or cooking (SR Legacy, FDC 171413), per 100 g: energy 884 kcal; total lipid 100 g; saturated 13.8 g; monounsaturated 73.0 g (18:1 71.3 g); polyunsaturated 10.5 g (18:2 9.76 g, 18:3 0.761 g); alpha-tocopherol 14.4 mg.
